/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]

Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: A
Q3: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: The fix-up asks to stop repeat clarify and plan attempts for #7251 only. Only option A covers all three ways #7251 can restart: the poller's standalone-stall sweep, a comment that triggers clarify, and an `/answer` that triggers plan. Each piece has a pattern to copy. The sweep in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (around lines 18708-18755) already holds an issue with `STALL_SKIP ... reason=security_dependency_held` and releases it with a `/reclarify` carrying a dedup marker. `clarify.yml` "Decide clarify route" (around line 514) already has an `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1 phase=clarify gate=security_dependency ... outcome=skip` early skip. `plan.yml` has no such gate yet, so option B would leave a gap, and option C would lose the automatic restart. All three checks hold only while PR #6667 is not merged into the default branch: one `GET pulls/6667` read, made only when the issue is #7251. They are off when `ISSUE_7251_DEPENDENCY_WAIT_ENABLED` is `false` or invalid; an invalid value also logs a warning. Each script sets the flag's default itself (§8), so with the flag unset every existing path runs unchanged.
Q2: Both plans define Phase 0 the same way: `grep -q '_AI_ENGINE_EXIT_REFUSED' scripts/ai_engine.sh` (both plans), plus `grep -q 'ai_engine_fallback_class' scripts/ai_engine.sh` (`docs/plans/claude-capacity-wait-plan.md` lines 179-182). Neither symbol is on `main` today; only the two plan docs mention them. So the poller can run Phase 0 deterministically against the default-branch tip once #6667 is merged, with no extra GitHub API call, and only then post one `/reclarify` with `<!-- ai:issue-7251-dependency-released:6667 -->`. Running the check before the restart is better than option B, because restarting #7251 when Phase 0 fails would just run clarify and plan into the same block. The planner still runs the Constraints-section preflight on its own, so the planner side of option C costs no new code.
Q3: If #6667 is closed without merging, Phase 0 can never pass, and waiting forever (option B) would strand #7251 with no automatic recovery. Option A posts one comment, with a dedup marker such as `<!-- ai:issue-7251-dependency-closed:6667 -->`, and puts back `ai:blocked`. That hands #7251 to the unblock judge, which has its own round caps, so no person is needed. The clarify and plan holds also release once #6667 is closed, so whatever the judge decides next is not suppressed.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
None. All three decisions are lettered. Notes for the planner:
- Q1:
  - In the poller, run the #7251 check before the security-dependency block. Make sure #7251 is evaluated even when its only pipeline signal is `ai:blocked` or its clarification-questions marker.
  - Log `STALL_SKIP issue=7251 reason=dependency_wait detail=open|merged|closed_unmerged|unverified action=none|reclarify|reblocked`.
  - If the PR read fails, treat the result as `unverified`: keep holding and post nothing.
  - The clarify and plan skips log `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1 phase=<clarify|plan> gate=issue_7251_dependency_wait reason=pr_6667_unmerged outcome=skip issue=7251`. They do not apply failure labels.
- Q2:
  - Read `scripts/ai_engine.sh` from the fetched default-branch tip, for example with `git show origin/<default>:scripts/ai_engine.sh`. If the read fails, keep holding and retry on the next tick.
  - If either Phase 0 check fails, post one comment marked `<!-- ai:issue-7251-preflight-failed:6667 -->` naming the missing symbol, send one Telegram WARNING, and post no `/reclarify`. The poller must not rebuild any of #6667's plumbing.
  - Leave the capacity-wait off switch (`CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED`) exactly as it is.
- Q3:
  - Only the closed-and-unmerged state re-applies `ai:blocked`.
  - A second check on the same tick finds the dedup marker and does nothing.
- Tests: add contract tests for each of the following:
  - the flag parse: unset, empty or `true` (any case) means on; `false` means off; any other value means off with a warning;
  - the three gates;
  - the merged release, both when Phase 0 passes and when it fails;
  - the closed-unmerged path;
  - dedup across ticks.
- Wiring: forward `ISSUE_7251_DEPENDENCY_WAIT_ENABLED` with a `true` fallback in `orchestrate_poll.yml`, `clarify.yml` and `plan.yml`.

ESCALATION (required for any ESCALATE decision):
None.
